mapper.insert: insert into models(model_name, model_type, model_path, predict_file_path, train_file_path, default_parameters, figure_path, remark, extract_labels, user_name, company_name) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{modelPath}, #{predictFilePath}, #{trainFilePath}, #{defaultParameters}, #{figurePath}, #{remark}, #{extractLabels}, #{userName}, #{companyName})
mapper.delete: delete models from models where model_id = #{modelId}
